title: Source product comparison for derived reduction by a regular principal quotient
statement: Let J be an essentially small site, R a commutative ring, r a nonzerodivisor generating I, and let P be a limiting product fan of a countable family of derived R-module sheaves. Tensoring its vertex and every projection by R/I gives another limiting product fan. The comparison is specified by the principal coefficient triangle, rather than by an arbitrary chosen witness.

proof.text: Tensor the principal coefficient triangle at the product vertex and at every family member. Form the morphism to the product triangle using the projections. The first two product comparisons are tensor-unit comparisons and are isomorphisms. The third is an isomorphism by the triangle five lemma. Transport the product limit along this actual third comparison. This is the real existing source construction.
